brief: Goldman's midday US equities color reports a broad bounce led by tech: NDX +130bps (reclaiming its 100-day moving average), R2K +81bps, SPX +67bps, but breadth stayed weak (286 names down, S&P ex-AI -50bps). The AI complex led, with neoclouds, optical, inference-chip, memory and semis baskets all sharply higher, and a long-software/short-semis pair moving the desk's preferred way. The desk attributes AI strength to three factors: easing of the 'AI financing concern' narrative after a successful META offering and an AVGO funding story overnight; anticipation of hyperscaler earnings and capex this week (GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN all report); and an oversold bounce aided by strong overnight EPS (CLS +15%). The momentum factor is also recovering after a roughly 20% drawdown, though the prime brokerage desk flags fundamental long/short momentum exposure near YTD lows, and the hedge fund positioning pair, while stabilizing today, remains down 10.5% month-to-date. On flows, long-only accounts skew better for sale (selling comms/macro, buying tech/consumer discretionary) while hedge funds are 10% better to buy on lighter notional. Liquidity improved even as overall volumes fell 7%.
